fusions.name: Bitter Trample
fusions.desc: Stamps the ground, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, knocking them 2.5 tiles back and leaving them [Poisoned] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Draw the Venom
fusions.desc: A kick that draws one of your afflictions back out of the target, dealing 8 damage and leaving it 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. It needs one of your afflictions on the target.

fusions.name: Run It Out
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 poison conditions from you, and you move 25% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Sweated Clean
fusions.desc: When a condition on you runs out, you regain 10 stamina. Once every 8 seconds.
